name: Normal dungeon bosses always drop at least one piece of gear, as Heroic and Mythic bosses do
contract: Project owner report (Uldaman on Normal at low level): not every boss dropped something. Heroic and Mythic bosses in the CoA dungeon list always drop exactly one weapon or armor piece; on Normal the loot script returned before that guarantee, so a boss only rolled its own table (Revelosh: 88% combined gear chance). Expected: on Normal a boss that rolled no gear gets one piece from its own loot pool; one that rolled several keeps all of them. Checked on two bosses whose pools hold a single quality, so the count is exact: Ferra in Dire Maul (14308, only uncommon gear, about 5% gear chance) and Marduk Blackpool in Scholomance (10433, only rare gear, about 13%).
